Finding.description: What a control found wrong in a part: the text at fault, and its line when it has one.

line.description: The line of the part the text starts on.

pattern.description: The expression that matched, when its control shows it.

rewrite.description: How to rewrite the text, from a judged rule.

text.description: The text at fault: a match, a budget's count, or a quoted sentence.

Finding.title: Finding

Verdict.description: One control's verdict on one part, as `controls.evaluate` gave it.

cached.description: Whether a judged verdict came from the cache.

findings.description: What the control found wrong, at most 20.

omitted.description: How many findings were left out past the first 20.

rule.description: The kind of the control's rule, or null for a written requirement.

status.description: passed, failed, skipped after a free rule failed, or stated.

Verdict.title: Verdict

description: `boundary/crossing/v1`: the verdicts on one content, at /crossings/<digest> in the personal board.

action.description: The capability that sends the parts, such as github.pr-create.

boundaries.description: The boundaries that matched, by their paths.

digest.description: The SHA-256 of the crossing's content, in 64 lowercase hex digits.

from.description: The checkout's path in the personal board, such as /repos/board; left out for a checkout no board mounts.

result.description: What the destination returned, such as a URL.

to.description: Where the parts go, such as github:octo/board.

verdicts.description: Each check's verdict on each part it applies to.

title: CrossingRecord
